result.reason: Actual-result evidence from this first live trial is uniformly positive but singular. The overlay produced exactly the behavior it prescribes, verified against the evaluation output rather than self-report: the original task received an honest FAIL (open next-unit work, open end goal, unchanged AGI evidence gate) while the bounded unit received a separately evidenced PASS whose deviation adjudication (PR 250 closed-not-merged) was contained inside unit_verdict; negative evidence references (red run 32607076987, retained heads, closure record) and the external claim boundary were preserved verbatim. Zero contradictory evidence was observed. One trial on one unit type is insufficient for PROPOSE_ACTIVATION: the overlay's expected scope (continual/incremental-task-evaluation) spans evaluation shapes this trial did not exercise (child units with continuation stacks, UNCERTAIN unit outcomes, FAIL units under a passing task). The candidate should accumulate trials across those shapes and then pass the deterministic protected-baseline regression gate; until then it remains a candidate with this positive observation recorded.
